computer_science_engineering.name: Department of Computer Science & Engineering
programs_offered: B.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering (4 Years, Intake: 240 seats (2026-27))
M.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering (2 Years)
computer_science_engineering.description: Established in 2008, accredited by NAAC with 'A' Grade, the department focuses on excellence in technical education, software development, client-server models, open-source technologies, and competitive coding.
computer_science_engineering.vision: To produce globally competent computer engineering professionals possessing strong analytical, algorithmic and ethical foundation.
mission: Providing contemporary computing laboratories and continuous academic learning.
Inculcating problem-solving abilities and practical software development skills.
Fostering research, patents, and active professional society chapters like IEEE and CSI.
labs: Object Oriented Programming (OOP / Java / Python) Lab
Open Source Software & Web Development Lab
computer_science_engineering.placement_highlights: Consistently high placement rate with recruitment in TCS, Infosys, Capgemini, Cognizant, Persistent Systems, Wipro, L&T Infotech, and Infocepts.

cse_aiml.name: Department of Computer Science & Engineering (Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning)
programs_offered: B.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering (AI & ML) (4 Years, Intake: 120 seats (2026-27))
cse_aiml.description: Dedicated to cutting-edge emerging technologies, preparing students for careers in Artificial Intelligence, Deep Learning, Natural Language Processing, Computer Vision, Cloud Computing, and Generative AI.
cse_aiml.vision: To emerge as a premier learning hub for Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning innovation and applications.
mission: Providing state-of-the-art GPU-enabled computing infrastructure for AI/ML experimentation.
Imparting rigorous foundation in mathematical algorithms, neural networks, and Python/PyTorch/TensorFlow frameworks.
Collaborating with leading technology industries for live projects and capstone hackathons.
labs: Natural Language Processing & Data Analytics Lab
cse_aiml.placement_highlights: High demand among recruiters for AI Engineers, ML Associates, Data Engineers, and Core Developers.

cse_data_science.name: Department of Computer Science & Engineering (Data Science)
programs_offered: B.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering (Data Science) (4 Years, Intake: 120 seats (2026-27))
cse_data_science.description: Focuses on big data analytics, predictive modeling, statistical learning, business intelligence, data engineering, and data pipeline architectures.
cse_data_science.vision: To excel in data science education, analytical research, and data-driven solutions for industry and societal challenges.
mission: Providing modern data computing platforms including Apache Spark, Hadoop, Python, and R.
Developing analytical mindset, business problem solving, and ethical data governance.
Bridging the gap between academic theory and industry data science practices.
cse_data_science.placement_highlights: Placement opportunities across analytics consultancies, financial institutions, IT services, and product companies.

electrical_engineering.name: Department of Electrical Engineering
programs_offered: B.Tech in Electrical Engineering (4 Years, Intake: 30 seats (2026-27))
electrical_engineering.description: Imparts comprehensive education in electrical machines, power systems, renewable energy, smart grids, electric vehicles (EV), and automation.
electrical_engineering.vision: To create competent electrical engineers proficient in power systems, green energy, and electrical automation.
mission: Equipping students with solid foundation in electrical circuits, drives, and control systems.
Fostering hands-on practical skills in industrial automation and renewable energy technologies.
Promoting professional student chapter activities through IEEE PES (Power & Energy Society).
labs: Renewable Energy & Smart Grid Simulation Lab
electrical_engineering.placement_highlights: Recruitment across core power sector, energy management, manufacturing, EPC contractors, and IT companies.

electronics_and_telecommunication.name: Department of Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering
programs_offered: B.Tech in Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering (4 Years, Intake: 60 seats (2026-27))
M.Tech in Electronics / VLSI Design (2 Years)
electronics_and_telecommunication.description: Offers robust education in wireless communications, VLSI design, embedded systems, Internet of Things (IoT), signal processing, and robotics.
electronics_and_telecommunication.vision: To emerge as a center of excellence in electronics, wireless communication, and embedded technologies.
mission: Providing industry-standard simulation software and hardware test benches for electronic circuits.
Empowering students with hands-on skills in FPGA, microcontrollers, IoT boards, and RF communications.
Promoting IETE and student forum (ELESA) technical events.
electronics_and_telecommunication.placement_highlights: Placements in semiconductor, telecommunications, networking, embedded hardware, and IT consultancy companies.

mechanical_engineering.name: Department of Mechanical Engineering
programs_offered: B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering (4 Years, Intake: 30 seats (2026-27))
mechanical_engineering.description: Emphasizes design engineering, thermal engineering, robotics, CAD/CAM/CAE, manufacturing technologies, and modern mechatronics.
mechanical_engineering.vision: To develop technically competent, ethically grounded, and innovative mechanical engineers.
mission: Providing advanced mechanical laboratories, modern CNC machining, and 3D modeling tools.
Encouraging participation in national vehicle competitions (BAJA SAE, Go-Kart, Solar Car).
Strengthening industry tie-ups for internships and industrial visits through student forum (MESA).
mechanical_engineering.placement_highlights: Recruiters include automotive, manufacturing, thermal power, automation, design consultancy, and IT services.

first_year_engineering.name: Department of First Year Engineering (Basic Sciences & Humanities)
programs_offered: Common Foundation Coursework for all B.Tech Branches (Intake: 240 seats (2026-27))
first_year_engineering.description: Lays the foundational groundwork in Applied Mathematics, Applied Physics, Applied Chemistry, Communication Skills, Engineering Mechanics, and Basic Programming.
first_year_engineering.vision: To establish a strong scientific foundation and nurture multidisciplinary thinking in budding engineers.
mission: Strengthening fundamental principles of science, mathematics, and professional communication.
Conducting student induction programs (SIP), mentoring, and diagnostic assessment tests.
Fostering ethical consciousness, team building, and transition into professional engineering.
first_year_engineering.placement_highlights: Builds fundamental aptitude and soft skills right from induction.
